//desktopName: Read by electron-builder (with linux.syncDesktopName) as the .desktop file name and the app_id/WM_CLASS Linux desktops match running windows against.
//@crew/supervisor: A devDependency on purpose, and it has to stay one. electron-builder packs every production dependency into app.asar no matter what `files` allows, and this one drags in the 190MB `claude` binary from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-<platform>. The packaged app never loads that copy — main/index.ts resolves the supervisor from process.resourcesPath, where scripts/after-pack.cjs puts a pruned tree — so it was 270MB of bundle nobody could reach. Dev still resolves it from node_modules, which devDependencies satisfies.
